name.zh: 拿到改规则的被动后重组玩法

summary.zh: 新被动不只加数值，还改变哪些组合成立、哪些牌值得留下。
summary.en: A passive changes which combinations are valid and which cards are worth keeping.

rules.zh: 少量被动直接修改基础规则，例如降低组合门槛或改变回合末处理方式。获得它之后，玩家重新评价现有牌和未来奖励；核心不是装满槽位，而是用新的规则组织整套打法。
rules.en: A few passives rewrite a base rule, such as pattern requirements or end-of-turn handling. After acquiring one, reassess the deck and future rewards around the changed rule.

loop.zh: 检查现有牌的价值变化

loop.en: Build a loop around the exception

decisions.zh: 这项新规则现在就能利用，还是要先花几场战斗改造牌组？
decisions.en: Can the new rule pay off now, or does it require several encounters of rebuilding?

decisions.zh: 原本有用的抽牌效果会不会因为不再自动弃牌而堵手？
decisions.en: Could useful draw effects become hand-clogging under a new retention rule?

effect.zh: 只改一个明确规则更易理解，连改多条容易让旧经验失效过多。
effect.en: One clear exception is easier to understand than several simultaneous rewrites.

effect.zh: 规则有趣但缺少配套牌时，会变成无从使用的承诺。
effect.en: An interesting rule without accessible supporting cards remains an empty promise.

contrast.zh: 前者放宽组合成立的条件；后者改变资源何时离开手中，重新塑造抽牌与费用管理。
contrast.en: One relaxes pattern requirements; the other changes when cards leave the hand, reshaping draw and cost management.

combination.zh: 设计提案：让一个被动允许仓库隔一格也算相邻，玩家拿到它后必须重新排货以利用新的连线。
combination.en: Design proposal: A passive lets storage items count as adjacent across one empty tile, prompting a new packing arrangement.

setup.zh: 编辑示例：原先必须五张同色才能点亮祭坛，玩家常常只凑到四张。
setup.en: Editorial example: an altar requires five matching colors, and the player often reaches only four.

action.zh: 玩家选取把门槛降为四张的被动。
action.en: Choose a passive reducing that requirement to four.

result.zh: 原本无法使用的手牌现在可以启动祭坛。
result.en: A previously invalid hand now activates the altar.

next.zh: 下一次奖励不再盲目加抽牌，而开始补祭坛触发后的收益。
next.en: Future rewards can support altar payoffs instead of only adding more draw.

firstStep.zh: 先做一个基础规则和一个明确例外，让同一手牌在获得被动前后可直接对比。
firstStep.en: Implement one base rule and one exception so the same hand can be compared before and after acquisition.

pitfall.zh: 不要把各种加伤害词条都叫改规则；首版必须改变至少一种合法行动。
pitfall.en: Do not label ordinary damage bonuses rule changes; alter at least one legal action.

test.zh: 玩家获得被动后会改变下一次选牌，并能指出新规则允许了什么。
test.en: Players change the next card choice and explain what became possible.
